objective: Test grounded literal repair and stalled-state supervision, then isolate added executed failure-recovery context; final test remains sealed until development selection passes.

shared_recipe.candidate_initialization: Each starts from the identical pinned base, never from a 019 adapter.

data.construction: Six targets per original admitted training task: inspect, repair, verify, submit, repair after a real read-only stall, late repair. Five targets per task are identical across candidates. Only the late slot changes: observed read-only context versus an executed failed-anchor attempt or an incorrect edit followed by failing tests. Wrong actions remain masked history, never supervised targets.
data.sample_selection: All 330 unique complete records per variant; same task/slot IDs and seed101 one-pass order; no dropping tasks, padding duplicates, or substituting evaluation examples.
data.repair_edit_operator: Python exact literal replacements with unique-anchor assertions checked before any file write; preserve ampersands/backslashes literally.
data.grounding: Search declared Python source for actual missing-implementation markers with line numbers; read declared short JavaScript modules. Never begin with an oracle line-number window.
data.training_token_accounting: Equal update and upper-bound budgets; actual input and supervised token counts may differ and must be reported. No equal-token or same-FLOP claim.

partitions.development: Same 15 observed development tasks as 019, rerun the unmodified base and both candidates once under identical inference ceilings. Reused development set is not independent validation.
partitions.historical: 24 observed 018 historical tasks, excluded from training and candidate selection
partitions.fresh: The same still-unopened 24 tasks across backoff, schedule, cssselect, addict; no replacement or inspection of model scores before selection.
partitions.fresh_repository_replacements: Only for rights, dependencies, clean/broken/restored controls or reference exposure, before any model score. Preserve exclusions. No replacement based on model difficulty/performance.

selection.criterion: highest development success; tie uses fewer total generated tokens; next tie lower learning rate
selection.if_no_eligible_candidate: Do not open fresh-test scores; record no selected candidate and no release.
selection.final_tie_break: Declared candidate order: repair before recovery; learning rates are identical.

release_gate.weights_release_scope: experimental LoRA adapter plus exact base revision; full merged model only after a separate verified export, never label adapter as complete 27B weights

publication.license_policy: Original code MIT; base and training-source licenses separately preserved. No third-party teacher API outputs.

failure_policy: Fix infrastructure before scoring, preserve failed attempts. After freeze no recipe/data/budget edits. Resume only identical inputs and remaining original 12h deadline; incomplete results are failures, no score-based retry.
limitations: Constructed repository defects, not historical issue benchmark results.
One training seed, 24 fresh tasks clustered in four repositories.
Python/JavaScript scope; no advanced multilingual or long-context certification.
Small supervised pilot; quality improvement is a measured outcome, not promised.
Training failure controls are deliberately constructed from training snapshots, not sampled model mistakes or distilled hidden reasoning.
